changelog: Add: FortiGate-style configuration backup and restore (download/upload .conf for a replacement unit)
Add: File Filter tab (type/AV inspect on submitted files)
Fix: deleting a NIC must not wipe VLAN netplan (eth1.10 / eth1.20 stay)
Fix: wg-watchdog must not bounce unused WireGuard when IPSec is the live path
Fix: dns-watchdog must not restart dnsmasq when an external DNS probe fails
